source.selection: payload.mstList where soundType === 3, preserving official array order
source.runtimeUrlSemantics: absolute file URI of the already-extracted official OGG source; no Viewer public deployment is implied
source.stableKeyContract: soundMstId + cueSheetName + cueName; all three fields are copied from the official getSoundMstList row
source.sourceStableKeyContract: cri-cue:cueSheetName=<official cueSheetName>|cueName=<official cueName>; consumers resolve it only to Cv/<cueSheetName>/<cueName>.ogg and never infer labels or subtitles
source.characterResourceIdContract: the exact six digits between cv_ and _outgame in official cueSheetName
source.orderContract: one-based occurrence order within each characterResourceId after preserving official soundType=3 manifest order
source.subtitleContract: subtitles remain empty in the audio catalog; exact Reaction locale rows and zh-Hant fallback metadata live only in the magius.voice-scenario.v1 companion manifest
source.durationContract: durationSeconds is omitted because no existing official duration manifest was consumed
